title: ores-api-docs RPC call frame
description: Transport-neutral call. HTTP carries the envelope on POST /v1/rpc while generated operation adapters decode semantic path/query/header/body sections and invoke the shared typed operation. WebSocket sends this object as a text frame. TCP sends this object as one NDJSON line (or a length-prefixed blob). Canonical wire keys are stable dotted rpc_key values; legacy identifier keys remain admitted during migration. This crate does not open sockets.

id.description: Caller-chosen correlation id. Copied onto the receipt.

key.description: Canonical stable dotted rpc_key, with legacy portable identifiers admitted during migration.

path.description: Path-template substitutions. Property names match {vars} in the route path.

headers.description: Normalized request headers / RPC metadata. HTTP field names are lowercase; values are route-schema-validated JSON scalars or arrays after wire decoding.

traceId.description: Optional W3C trace id. Same field name as ores-otel log-context; copied, not interpreted. This crate does not depend on ores-otel.

spanId.description: Optional W3C span id. Same field name as ores-otel log-context.
